# Sovereign Enterprise

> A full AI company on its own devices. Six AI agents (sales, service, finance, operations, systems, audit) run the company end to
> end; two humans watch. Every device is a brain — a verified, readable pattern library (the Konomi SLM) that answers only inside
> what it was verified on and abstains outside it — and the brains share what they learn over a signed peer-to-peer spine. Money and
> security calls need a second, independent brain to agree; what no brain can confirm waits for a human. Nothing leaves the building.

Live: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/sovereign-enterprise/
White paper: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/sovereign-enterprise/whitepaper.html
Source: https://github.com/sjgant80-hub/sovereign-enterprise

## How the AI company works
- Each agent is a device with its own Ed25519 key, a grant scoped to its department, and a dedicated brain file it re-verifies on its
  own data before trusting it.
- Work lands at a door that does not know who handles it; an agent that cannot answer asks the mesh, and the device whose brain covers
  the case answers with a receipt.
- An agent asked about the same work repeatedly adopts the published brain — only if it re-verifies on its own data. A poisoned brain
  is refused by every device that checks it.
- High-stakes calls (holding a payment, credit terms, quarantining a machine) need an independent brain on another device to agree; the
  Audit agent grows its own for exactly that.
- Outcomes come back; an agent regrows its brain and promotes the new one only if it beats the old on outcomes neither saw.
- Inbound text is screened for invisible characters, bidi tricks, tag-character smuggling and injection phrasing before any brain reads it.

## Measured (re-runnable: node tools/run-company.mjs --check)
- A working day of 480 pieces of work: 77.7% done end to end by agents; 76.7% of agent calls matched the real outcome; 120 money and
  security calls confirmed by an independent second brain; a poisoned brain refused by 5 of 5 devices; every device converged; books
  balanced; vault audited.

## The white paper — the AI-native office
- AI runs 90% of a modelled 50-person UK office's operational work on owned machines; five AI-native people oversee it.
- Five-year cost: £12.6m today, £12.7m with an AI seat on every desk, £2.3m AI-native and owned — £10.3m saved (82%).

## Proof
- Unit, boundary, hostile-input and integration suites; two byte-reproducible re-runs (the AI company's working day; a hostile-network
  simulation); a mutation + fuzz witness over every decision kernel.
